_doc: Emerald's 10 one-time move tutors (written by converter/gen_items.py with HOENN_VERSION=emerald from pokeemerald data/scripts/move_tutors.inc, text/move_tutors.inc, src/data/pokemon/tutor_learnsets.h). map = the HoennB2 map the tutor's Emerald map plays, at = its tile there, built = this build has the map; lines = Teach / WhichMon / Declined / Taught in Black 2 text form; species = who can learn the move (Emerald). The tutor mechanism is EMERALD-4 (emerald_mech); the 20 Battle Frontier tutors (BattleFrontier_Lounge7) wait for the Frontier.

lines.WhichMon: All right, which Pokémon wants to\nlearn how to Swagger?
lines.Declined: What, no? Can’t you get into\nthe spirit of things?
lines.Taught: I’ll just praise my Pokémon from now\non without the swagger.

lines.WhichMon: Ehehe, sure thing! It’d be great if\nthe Pokémon looked like me.
lines.Declined: You don’t need to be shy about it.\nLet’s roll!
lines.Taught: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let’s roll!

lines.WhichMon: Yay!\nShow me which Pokémon I should teach.
lines.Declined: We’re not on the same wavelength.
lines.Taught: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!

lines.WhichMon: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the Pokémon{be00}\nyou wish me to teach.
lines.Declined: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach Mimic\nto your Pokémon!
lines.Taught: Mimic is a move of great depth.{be01}\nCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?

lines.WhichMon: Okay! I’ll teach it!\nWhich Pokémon should I teach?
lines.Declined: Okay. I’ll be here if you change\nyour mind.

lines.WhichMon: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich Pokémon should I teach?
lines.Declined: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith Hidden Power, too…
lines.Taught:
I’ve never once gotten my wife’s
coin trick right.{be01}
I would be happy if I got it right
even as I Sleep Talk…

lines.WhichMon: Giggle…\nWhich Pokémon do you want me to{be00}\nteach Substitute?
lines.Declined: Oh, no?{be01}\nA Pokémon can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.
lines.Taught: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!{be01}\nI hope you’ll get that way, too!

lines.WhichMon: What? You do? You’re a good person!\nWhich Pokémon should I teach?
lines.Declined: Darn! You’re even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!
lines.Taught: I want you to win at the Mossdeep Gym\nusing that Dynamicpunch!

lines.WhichMon: Okay, which Pokémon should I teach\nDouble-Edge?
lines.Taught: I won’t live for love anymore!\nI’ll become tough!

lines.WhichMon: Fine! An Explosion it is!\nWhich Pokémon wants to blow up?
lines.Declined: Gaah! You’re turning me down because\nI live in the country?
